build_vision_transformer_backbone: build a VisionTransformer backbone with configurable patch size, embedding dims, and number of layers
build_transformer_encoder_layer: build a TransformerEncoderLayer with multihead attention and feed-forward network for ViT
resize_positional_embedding: resize the positional embedding weights using bicubic interpolation to match new input image size
freeze_vit_parameters: freeze VisionTransformer parameters except those listed in frozen_exclude for transfer learning
initialize_vit_weights: initialize VisionTransformer weights using trunc_normal or load pretrained checkpoint via init_cfg
